Based in the Marketing & Branding Department within the Head Office, Port Moresby, the
Senior Marketing and Branding Officer
performs key duties to drive the development and implementation of marketing and branding initiatives that enhance the company’s visibility, reputation, and market presence through the online, digital and social media platform. This role ensures brand consistency, well coordinated campaigns, and effective engagement across online, website, digital, and social media platforms to support business growth.

Manage the organisation’s social media and online presence by publishing content, monitor engagement, track performance metrics, and recommending improvements.

Experience using design tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Suite) is an advantage.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to analyse marketing data and generate insights and recommendations.
Proven organisation and project management abilities.
Attention to detail and brand consistency.
Proven creativity and content development skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and digital marketing platforms.

Head of Human Capital, Moni Plus, PO Box 1748, Boroko, NCD via         email
[email protected]
and apply now.

Wednesday, 22nd July 2026.

27684.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your impact
You will drive local procurement initiatives that make a real impact on operational excellence and sustainable outcomes. You will lead key procurement projects, craft market documentation, evaluate bids, and build strong relationships with suppliers to deliver efficient, compliant, and high-value results. Your work will shape supplier development, strengthen community engagement, and enhance operational performance across the site.
As part of our team, you will
Lead and support PNG and Lihirian procurement activities, including running RFPs, negotiating with suppliers, and managing commercial disputes.
Support site stakeholders and the Category Management teams to identify and develop local procurement opportunities.
Ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and company policies, including health, safety, environmental, ESG, and community engagement standards.
Build supplier capability through coaching, advisory documents, and ongoing support.
Contribute to the Local Procurement Plan and reporting, providing insights to improve processes and outcomes.
Present procurement outcomes to managers and other stakeholders, fostering collaboration and transparency.
Prerequisites for your success in this role
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Procurement, or related field is desirable.
Proven experience in procurement and supplier capacity building, ideally in a mining environment.
Skilled in supplier negotiations, both to achieve great contract value and resolving contract related disputes
Competence in SAP, Fieldglass and Ariba is desirable.
Excellent communication, negotiation, public speaking, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong cultural awareness, particularly in engaging with Lihirian communities and local businesses.
Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with a focus on building long-term relationships and delivering value.
Ability to work independently as a motivated self-starter while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Your work environment
This role is offered on a Monday-Friday roster, to be based in Port Moresby.
Why join Newmont
At Newmont, you will have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on site operations while developing your career in a global mining environment. You will work with a team that values collaboration, innovation, and cultural awareness, and you will contribute to sustainable, ethical procurement practices that support local communities and operational excellence.
Submit your application through our website quoting reference number 43470 before the advertised closing date: 22 July 2026.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply – we’d love to hear from you!
Apply

K92 Mining Limited operates the Kainantu Gold Mine in the Eastern Highlands Province. Since we launched in 2016, we've grown gold production every year, boosting Papua New Guinea's economy. We take pride in supporting your communities, with nearly 94% of our team members being fellow PNG locals.
Looking ahead, we will significantly increase our gold production in the next three years. This expansion means that K92 is a place for building a stable career, contributing to the community, and being a key part of our success.
About the role

27805.description:
With more than 40 years of experience working in PNG, World Vision Papua New Guinea (WVPNG) focuses on helping the most vulnerable children and adults experience fullness of life.  Inspired by our Christian faith, World Vision Papua New Guinea(WVPNG) has an exciting opportunity for someone who maybe looking for a change and wants to become part of a dynamic team helping vulnerable people and communities.
We are currently looking for suitable, qualified, experienced, and highly motivated professional to fill the role of
Sourcing Coordinator
to be based in
Port Moresby, National Capital District.
MAJOR ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategy Development & Planning
Review National Office and Area Program Annual Procurement Plan or Activity Plan to prepare Annual or Quarterly Procurement Plan in National Office and Area Program level in collaboration with Supply Chain Manager.
Review Area program Sourcing Plan to prepare Area Program Sourcing Plan which aligned with National Sourcing Plan.
Execute strategic and tactical contract in Provision at Area program and National level.
Implement strategic sourcing plan based on approved annual/quarterly procurement plan or Historical spend on Coupa at national and area program level.
Resource Acquisition & Management
Look for opportunities to build strong and strategic relation with vendor at National Office and Area Program level to reduce tactical/transactional buying.
Visit Area programs at least on a quarterly basis
Capacity Building
Provide technical advice for area program team in developing procurement plan, strategy and implementation.
Provide capacity building, guidance and support on procurement system (Provision End-to-End, Gabi, WatchDog) at Area program and field/national office level)
Provide Supply Chain orientation at Area program and field/national office level
Accountability & Quality Assurance:
Prepare document for Sub/Committee process at National Office level.
Implement bidding process at National level as standard, include sending invitation to bid to vendor and prepare regret letter and confirm letter to vendor.
Work together with technical person and or department to ensure procurement plan and process is aligned with their needs.
The following major responsibilities are applicable at National Office and Area Program levels;
Conduct vendor evaluations and prequalification (e.g., Block Party Screening, Safeguarding Code of Conduct, Business Registration, Tax Certificates)
Perform Supplier Information Management (SIM) in Coupa for supplier registration and onboarding
Update, review, and appraise vendor lists periodically
Ensure 90% of procurements are captured in Coupa to meet Provision Spend KPIs.
Minimize offline sourcing and prioritize Coupa online sourcing
Manage Provision access requests and updates for end-users and buyers
Support and respond to general inquiries related to Provision
Align all procurement processes with organizational standards
Networking & Coordination:
Coordinate with Procurement at Area Program level on doing procurement analysis needed for implementation of strategic sourcing.
Coordinate with NO and Area Program on procurement process
Develop good networking with vendors and consultants/contractors and update their information for organization
Management & Leadership: Key Responsibilities (National Office and Area Program Levels):
Extract and consolidate Open PO Reports and Procurement Reports from Coupa monthly and submit to SCM.
Ensure Buyer actions are completed within 72 hours/3 days at both levels. • Provide weekly updates on assigned tasks via Office 365 Planner
Facilitate and perform Secretary role in Procurement Committee Meetings in the absence of SCM or as required
EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION/SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE
Relevant Diploma/Degree qualifications in Supply Chain Management, Procurement and Logistics, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field.
Diploma or Certificate in Procurement and Supply (e.g., CIPS certification) or Certified Humanitarian Procurement Professional (CHPP).
Minimum 5 years’ experience in logistics and procurement work, preferably with grant management knowledge in dealing with procurement and logistics.
For candidates without a degree or diploma, relevant experience (e.g., 3+ years) in sourcing, procurement, or supply chain roles in PNG
Training in Coupa Procurement System or similar tools.
Short courses in vendor management, contract management, or procurement strategies.
Familiarity with contract lifecycle management and supplier evaluation processes.
A competitive salary, benefits, and career development opportunity will be offered commensurate with relevant experience, knowledge, and qualifications.
Interested applicants should submit the following documents all in one PDF file before;
Monday 20 July, 2026
,
(Midnight, PNG Time)
Expression of interest
Detailed CV
World Vision is committed to the principles of workplace diversity. Qualified women and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.
World Vision is committed to safeguarding all children and adults living where World Vision operates. We enforce a zero tolerance policy for any forms of violence, abuse and exploitation against children or adults, either by employees or others affiliated with our work. We do not employ staff whose background is not aligned with our safe guarding practices. Employment is conditional upon successful completion of all mandatory background checks, including criminal record checks, where required.
We appreciate the time it takes to prepare your application. Please note that only short-listed candidates suitable for interviews will be contacted. If you do not hear from World Vision within
two (2) weeks
of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful.
Apply

27734.description:
Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea is one of PNG’s largest food companies, manufacturing and distributing high-quality Flour, Stock Feed, Rice, Snacks, and Bakery products throughout the country. Well-known products and brands include Flame Flour, Flame Stockfeed, Flame Oil & Sugar, Flame Rice, Bilas Bread, Skel Rice, Twisties snacks, Arthurs Pies, and the Meadow Lea range.
At GFI, we care about making food better for everyone.
Our goal is to be the leading and most innovative food company with a mission to meet our customers’ needs for superior quality foods with brands that are trusted by families everywhere.  We are the go-to source of consumer, shopper, and customer insights to help our customer and business partners succeed.
We currently have an immediate vacancy for an
Electrical Engineer
who will be responsible for ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of all electrical systems, automation equipment, and production machinery within the
Utilities Department
at
Goodman Fielder Lae
. This role supports continuous improvement, reduces downtime, and ensures compliance with safety and quality standards across the manufacturing site. Also, responsible for following up on work in the utilities area and coordinating the daily operations of generators, air compressors, and water treatment systems. Proficient in computer operation and able to independently operate equipment such as air compressors and generators.
Your
responsibilities
will include
:
Electrical Maintenance & Troubleshooting
Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical systems, motors, drives, PLCs, and control panels.
Diagnose electrical faults and implement timely solutions to minimise production downtime.
Ensure all electrical work complies with PNG electrical standards and internal safety policies.
Automation & Control Systems
Support PLC programming, SCADA systems, and automated production lines.
Monitor and optimise machine performance through control system adjustments.
Assist in upgrades, modifications, and commissioning of new equipment.
Project Engineering
Participate in engineering projects including installations, upgrades, and plant expansions.
Prepare technical specifications, drawings, and documentation for electrical works.
Liaise with contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure project success.
Compliance, Safety & Quality
Ensure all electrical systems meet safety, environmental, and food manufacturing compliance requirements.
Conduct risk assessments, JHAs, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Maintain accurate maintenance records and ensure audit readiness.
Continuous Improvement
Analyse equipment performance data to identify improvement opportunities.
Recommend and implement solutions to improve reliability, efficiency, and energy usage.
Support TPM, Lean, and other operational excellence programs.
To be considered for the role, you will need to have
:
Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in industrial or manufacturing environments.
Strong knowledge of PLCs (Siemens/Allen Bradley), VSDs, sensors, and automation systems.
Experience with high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems.
Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Be part of the Skel life and join a team that values healthy eating and active lifestyles and wants to share that with all the people of PNG.  Still interested? Send your letter of application and CV/resume with at least 2 referees to:
The Recruitment Team
Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea
P O. Box 673, Port Moresby NCD PNG
E-mail:
[email protected]
Please submit your application in PDF and in
only one attachment
.
Applications close
Monday 20th July, 2026.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Apply

Boiler Operation & Monitoring

Head of People & Culture
to join its Senior Leadership Team.
The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping the organisation's people strategy as it continues its transformation and growth journey across the region.
The Opportunity
Reporting directly to the Group Chief Executive Officer and leading a robust People & Culture team, this is a genuine strategic leadership role. The organisation already has mature People & Culture policies, systems and frameworks in place. The opportunity for the successful candidate lies in
strategic execution
— driving talent acquisition in an increasingly competitive market, strengthening succession planning and leadership pipelines, and ensuring the People & Culture function operates as a true business partner to the Executive team.

Develop and lead a holistic 3–5 year People & Culture Strategy aligned to the organisation's strategic plan

Strong understanding of People & Culture systems, including payroll and learning management systems
Sound knowledge of executive remuneration, job evaluation methodologies (e.g. Hay) and incentive frameworks

Detailed understanding of relevant statutory and employment law across PNG and the wider Pacific region (an advantage)
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management (essential); a Bachelor's degree in Financial Services is highly regarded

Commercially minded and metrics-driven, with a strategic mindset
Resilient and tenacious, with the ability to excel under pressure
High levels of integrity and personal ethics

More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
As K92 continues expanding at our mine site in the Eastern Highlands, we have an ambitious program of community projects that we are delivering in 2026 and 2027, in this role you will, you will act as the owners’ representative and have overall responsibility for managing, coordinating and supervising all construction activities associated with the delivery of the Kainantu community related to ITCS and EASD Projects
Key Accountabilities
Manage construction schedules and resource plans with approved budgets and in the context of the overall project schedule.
Manage construction risks and ensure contingency plans are in place to minimize negative impact.
Management of both contractor and independent consultant contracts
Lead cross-functional teams to achieve project deliverables and objectives.
Collaborate with the B2B, Project Manager, contractors, and owners’ team to ensure project success.
Develop and maintain construction quality documentation and ensure construction compliance with overall projects QA/QC plan.
Facilitate meetings and ensure effective communication with all project stakeholders and the community.
Manage change and ensure that changes are properly documented and approved.
Ensure that multi-disciplinary project deliverables align with the project scope, quality, and specifications.
Community works related to ITCS & EASD projects – Primarily roads, schools, medical facilities.
Ensure construction is conducted in compliance with Papua New Guinea laws, regulations, project specific and company standards.
Conduct regular and thorough inspections of work areas to ensure compliance with engineering, design, legislation, safety, and environment standards.
About You
To be considered for this role, you will need all or the following
Strong projects background with demonstrated ability to bring projects to completion on time and on budget.
Formal trade or Engineering qualifications in an appropriate discipline.
Familiarity with project management tools and methodologies, such as PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile Adaptable
PNG Driver’s License (or ability to get one).
Post graduate studies in Construction Management or a related technical discipline.
Desirable – Certificate in Workplace Assessment and Training or similar
A sound knowledge of risk management practices and risk-based decision making.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Understanding of PNG Safety and Health legislation.
Good planning, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong active listening & interpersonal skills for rapport building, conflict resolution & training.
Surface mining project or construction related experience is required
Self-motivated with the ability to work under pressure and autonomously.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.

1. Administrative & Compliance Assistant
Job Summary
The Administrative & Compliance Assistant is responsible for providing administrative, compliance, and property management support to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the business. The role includes managing documentation, maintaining records, coordinating maintenance activities, assisting with lease administration, and supporting compliance requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Provide administrative support to management and staff.
Reply to emails and correspondence in a timely and professional manner.
Coordinate and schedule meetings, conferences, and appointments.
Maintain and update property records and the master property database using Microsoft Excel.
Maintain and update Linpossible and other company databases.
Organize and maintain filing systems for lease agreements, utility bills, rental invoices, contracts, reports, and other company records.
Assist in the preparation, review, and administration of lease agreements and contracts.
Monitor lease and contract expiry dates and assist with renewals.
Coordinate maintenance requests and repairs for company-managed properties.
Liaise with landlords, tenants, contractors, and service providers regarding maintenance and property-related matters.
Follow up on maintenance works to ensure timely completion and satisfactory outcomes.
Prepare and maintain reports relating to properties, leases, rentals, utilities, maintenance, and compliance matters.
Occasionally travel off-site to deliver rental invoices, utility bill invoices, contracts, and other company documents.
Assist in ensuring compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Support audit and compliance activities by maintaining accurate and complete records.
Perform other administrative and compliance duties as assigned by management.
2. Maintenance Supervisor -
Key Responsibilities:
Supervise and coordinate all preventive and corrective maintenance activities for facilities, equipment, and building systems.
Ensure maintenance works are completed efficiently and in compliance with safety standards.
Monitor the condition and performance of equipment and facilities, identifying maintenance requirements and recommending improvements.
Manage maintenance schedules, work orders, and inventory of tools, materials, and spare parts.
Coordinate with contractors and service providers for specialized maintenance and repair works.
Maintain accurate maintenance records and prepare reports as required.
Qualifications:
Proven experience as a Maintenance Supervisor or in a similar maintenance role.
Strong knowledge of facility maintenance, including electrical, plumbing, mechanical, and building systems.
Preferably a qualified Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Technician with hands-on experience in the installation, maintenance, and repair of air conditioning systems.
Ability to diagnose and resolve maintenance-related issues effectively.
Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.
Willing to work flexible hours and respond to maintenance emergencies when required.
3. IT Officer / IT Administrator

IT Infrastructure & Systems
Maintain and monitor company servers, network systems, internet connectivity, and IT infrastructure.
Install, configure, and troubleshoot hardware, software, printers, and other IT equipment.
Manage user accounts, email systems, and access permissions.
Ensure data backup, recovery, and system security procedures are implemented.
Technical Support
Provide technical support to employees for hardware, software, and network-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve IT problems in a timely manner.
Coordinate with external IT vendors and service providers when necessary.
Asset Management
Maintain an inventory of IT equipment, software licenses, and accessories.
Monitor issuance, transfer, maintenance, and disposal of IT assets.
Ensure proper documentation of all IT assets and equipment.
Cybersecurity & Compliance
Implement and monitor IT security policies and procedures.
Manage antivirus, firewall, and endpoint security solutions.
Ensure compliance with company IT policies and data protection requirements.
System Improvement & Projects
Recommend and implement technology solutions to improve operational efficiency.
Assist in IT-related projects, system upgrades, and digital transformation initiatives.
Prepare IT reports, documentation, and user guides as required.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
At least 3 years of experience in IT support, system administration, or network management.
Knowledge of Windows Server, Microsoft 365, networking, and cybersecurity principles.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and user support skills.

27629.description:
Warehouse Manager
The stock-control, no-shortage kind
Location:
Atlas, Port Moresby
Employment:
Full-time, Local Hire
Important:
If you do not have proven warehouse, stores, stock control, inventory, or purchasing experience, please do not submit your CV.
Atlas is part of the Kenmore Group of Companies and supports projects across building, steel, construction, hardware, and civil works.
We’re looking for an experienced Warehouse Manager to take control of warehouse operations, stock management, inventory accuracy, and purchasing support.
This is not a role for someone who only knows how to move stock around. We need someone who understands stock systems, warehouse discipline, purchasing, stock security, cycle counts, stocktakes, supplier follow-ups, and how to keep operations supplied without delays.
If your experience is limited, this is not the one to test it on.
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be responsible for managing the day-to-day warehouse operations, including receipting, storage, picking, issuing, dispatch, stock control, and project material movements.
That includes maintaining accurate inventory records, managing stock movements, setting reorder levels, raising purchase requisitions and orders, following up suppliers, checking deliveries, and reporting shortages, damage, or non-conformances.
You’ll also manage cycle counts, stocktakes, stock variances, slow-moving stock, obsolete stock, damaged stock, warehouse security, housekeeping, and safe storage practices.
You’ll lead storemen and warehouse staff, manage forklift and equipment usage, and make sure stock is issued correctly to the right jobs, departments, projects, or accounts.
You’ll work closely with the Branch Manager, Steel House Manager, Financial Controller, project managers, fabrication teams, construction teams, sales staff, suppliers, freight providers, and clearance agents.
The expectation is simple: control the stock, protect the warehouse, support the projects, and keep the records accurate.
Who This Suits
This role suits an experienced Warehouse Manager, Stores Manager, Inventory Controller, or senior warehouse professional with real supervisory experience.
You understand stock systems, stocktakes, cycle counting, purchasing, supplier follow-up, warehouse layout, stock security, loss prevention, and safe handling of construction, hardware, and steel materials.
You should be confident using Excel for stock reporting, stock analysis, and management updates.
You know how to lead people, not just count stock. You can supervise warehouse staff, enforce procedures, control stock movements, and keep the warehouse clean, safe, and organised.
You are accurate, honest, reliable, practical, and serious about preventing stock losses, shortages, and write-offs.
If people already rely on you to bring order to a busy warehouse, this will feel familiar.
Why You’ll Like Working Here
Atlas is involved in real building, steel, construction, hardware, and civil works projects.
You’ll be part of a business where good warehouse control directly supports project delivery, cost control, and customer service.
This is a role where accuracy matters, stock discipline is noticed, and strong warehouse managers are taken seriously.
How to Apply
If you’re reading this and thinking, “I can control this properly,” then we want to hear from you.
Send your CV and cover letter to:
HR Team

Applications close: Saturday, 18 July 2026
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Here you’ll make a difference
Save the Children is the world’s largest independent child rights development organisation, making a difference to children’s lives in more than 100 countries. From emergency relief to long-term development, Save the Children secures a child’s right to health, education, and protection. At Save the Children, we attract bright and big-hearted people who are inspired to make a difference. Together, we are fearless in our pursuit of making lasting change for the children and communities who need it most. In Papua New Guinea (PNG), Save the Children implements programs in the sectors of health, education, child protection, child rights governance, and livelihoods. Save the Children’s program portfolio includes Maternal Child Health programming, including most recently a project to improve maternal nutrition and maternal child health funded by DFAT in Simbu and East New Britain Provinces; and is therefore seeking a lead for this project.
Here your skills will be valued - Role Purpose
The Maternal Child Health (MCH) Manager reports to the Senior Health and Nutrition Program Manager and will provide leadership and oversight of the DFAT-funded MCH project across Simbu and ENB Provinces. The MCH Manager ensures the technical support and oversight on all MCH program components. This will also include quality and timely delivery (within budget) of the project outcomes and contributing to staff-management, budget management and capacity building of provincial and facility-based staff across ENB and Chimbu provinces. The manager will also be required to contribute to additional MCH programming as relevant.
Key Areas of Accountability
Program Management
Ensure that MCH outcomes are effectively managed on time, within budget, and with quality, through direct management of the project team.
Technical knowledge of Labor-room management, ante-natal care quality improvement and active management of 3
rd
stage of labor (AMTSL) together with experience working within L1 or L2 health facilities.
Ensure that MCH programming is in line with current global practices adapted to the local context and based on sound evidence, using Save the Children’s common approaches where relevant.
Maintain a holistic approach to MCH programming, understanding and strengthening the links between MCH and other health and nutrition programming, as feasible and relevant.
Ensure all MCH programming meaningfully integrates principles of gender equality, disability and inclusion (GEDSI) at all levels, identifying and reducing barriers to access.
Ensure that all relevant project method management (PMM) and mandatory tools are prepared, disseminated, and regularly updated as needed in line with project and/or external changes.
Ensure that all project teams fully understand the MCH project design, objectives, deliverables, and intended impact, outcomes and outputs.
Contribute to MCH technical and program briefs / communications as requested.
Budget and Financial Management
Serve as budget holder (as delegated) and budget manager for the MCH program.
Review and approve all financial transactions within delegated limits, ensuring the application of all financial and procurement policies and compliance standards.
Ensure that the MCH program budget is properly forecasted and reviewed monthly; review transaction listings, monitor and address variances within SCA and donor requirements.
Assist in the preparation of budgets for new MCH programs as relevant and requested.
Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) and Reporting:
Work with the MEAL team to ensure that the MCH program has an updated log frame, MEAL workbook and data collection tools; ensure teams know how to use them.
Work with the MEAL sure that program data is collated, analysed and used to assess project performance at all levels and to inform learning.
Co-organize regular review meetings and learning events that use project data to ensure learning is used to guide project implementation, design, and adaptation.
Lead on preparing MCH program donor reports and other official documentation in line with donor requirements and SCA quality standards.
Work with the MEAL team to ensure that all beneficiary feedback and accountability systems are functional, accessible, and used, including by children and marginalized groups.
Assist with MCH research or assessments required for development or humanitarian programming, in collaboration with internal and external teams.
External Relations; Stakeholder Management
Maintain strong relationships with government and non-government stakeholders in Simbu Province and support the same in ENB Province.
Represent Save the Children in key provincial coordination mechanisms as relevant to the sector.
Team Management
Provide line management, mentoring, and coaching for the MCH team.
Ensure that all team members have updated performance plans/reviews, and development plans based on identified capacity gaps. Facilitate regular 1-1 and (documented) team meetings.
Ensure that all team members understand and comply with all Save the Children, donor, and other applicable policies, principles, and procedures, including mandatory trainings.
Lead on recruiting new team members as relevant / appropriate. Ensure staff have completed all mandatory training and have up-to-date background checks.
Safeguarding Requirements
Maintain a child-safe environment at the workplace and safeguard children’s rights, always acting in the best interests of children, as well as safeguarding all beneficiaries.
Comply with the Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct and child safeguarding and protection. policies and standards, as well as all other related policies, including reporting requirements.
Demonstrate the highest standards of behaviour towards children in private/professional life.
General
Fulfill other management duties (such as Extended Management Team Member) as required.
Be a role model for safety and security and comply with all workplace safety policies, procedures, work instructions and training, including all reporting requirements and processes.
Participate in, and contribute to, health and safety awareness and improvements.
Be aware of, document and manage the risks associated with the program activities, operations and workplaces, ensuring appropriate elimination or mitigation measures are applied.
Any other relevant duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Never abuse the position of trust that comes with being part of Save the Children’s family.
Maintain a safe and positive relationship when working with children and young people.
Respond to any concerns for the safety or wellbeing of a child in a program in accordance with Save the Children mandatory reporting processes.
Health, Safety, Security and Risk Management

27448.description:
SCU Admission Officer
Student Services Department - Port Moresby, NCD
ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT:
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 34 years. Today we are in one of the largest business schools in the country and offer degree programs in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies, and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 11 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field.
Our success is the fruit of our dedicated team committed to making a difference in Papua New Guinea, through their efforts to help educate current and future citizens on Papua New Guinea.
A CAREER WITH US:
At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learned skills. Our recruitment process is designed to help candidates understand this and enable us to better match you with a role that you will not only be able to do but enjoy doing. Career progression is also important to us and we believe that each employee should be in the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.
Position Title: SCU Admission Officer
Department: Student Services Department
Location: IBSUniversity, Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
Position Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Team Leader - SCU Admissions
Key Relationships: Students, Parents, Sponsors, Student Data Officers, Course Advisor, Academic Secretary, Team Leaders, Registrar’s Office and Academics, Scholarship Officer.
ABOUT THIS ROLE:
The sole purpose of this role is to ensure that students are properly enrolled in their courses as per their year levels and program of study.
Key Responsibilities:
Screening of applications
Processing of applications
Entering of data into ERP Academia system and other related software if necessary
Provide effective customer service and answering to walk-in enquiries
Qualifications
(1) Education:
Preferably a diploma or degree in any Business-related field with Cert II, III or IV in I.T
(2) Skills and Abilities:
Must have a minimum of 2 or more years of work experience in student administration at a Higher Educational Institution or related field.
Must have good communication skills
Must be computer literate and have a good knowledge on Microsoft Applications
Have good customer service skills
Must have adequate knowledge and Skills on CRM and SMS Software and ERP Academia
Working Conditions
The position is based at the IBS University 11 Mile Campus, Port Moresby.
The normal working hours are from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. The lunch break may be taken from either 12:00 noon to 1:00 p.m. or 1:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m., subject to operational requirements.
The incumbent may be required to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, as directed by the Team Leader or SCU Coordinator to meet operational needs.
Terms and Conditions
Transportation to and from work is provided from the employee's nearest designated bus stop.
The successful applicant will be entitled to annual leave and sick leave in accordance with IBS University policies and employment conditions. Annual leave accrues upon completion of the qualifying service period, and employees are entitled to ten (10) days of paid sick leave per annum.

27260.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our security team, you will receive and transmit communications using CCTV footage equipment in accordance with government regulations. In this role you will ensure security on site whilst meeting safety standards at our underground gold mine.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Monitoring and controlling bank screens in the central control room
Maintain and monitor all cameras footage of   surveillance cameras located in the mine site.
Monitor emergency frequencies to detect distress calls and respond in
dispatching assistance.
Operate CCTV equipment to communicate with employees, work colleagues, drivers, exploration personnel, business partners and other stakeholders.
Conduct periodic equipment inspections and routine tests to ensure that operations standards are met.
Coordinate camera -related aspects of locating and contacting employees and business partners who are missing or in distress.
Examine and operate new equipment prior to installation to ensure that it performs properly.
Send, receive, and interpret coded messages via monitor cameras.
Answer telephone calls to take messages, answer questions, and provide information during non-business hours or when switchboard is closed.
Support and assist the APD team to ensure the rectification of identified defect equipment to improve and optimise availability and reliability targets.
Work closely with the Coordinator APD to assess performance and identify improvement projects to maximise results, reduce risk and implement cost management initiatives.
Maintain the Gold Room security system and ensure that the contract between the owners and contractors relating to the movement of gold, is conducted in accordance with K92 Mining Limited`s procedures.
Continuously mentor and coach technicians on effective repair techniques.
Identify skills gaps and training requirements and assist in developing training packages as required to close the skills gap.
Actively review the work performance of APD Supervisors and provide feedback to the APD Superintendent including the talent and succession planning for designated key roles.
Actively promotes a safe and healthy culture.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Possess current Grade 12 or above education
The incumbent shall have worked for at least 3 years or more preferably in a mining environment but must have passed out from a recognized security training institution with no criminal record.
Knowledge of CCTV usage and radio transmission systems is required, including the ability to use a wide range of transmitters, switches, and controls to overcome communication hurdles
Acute listening skills are required to determine the urgency of received messages
Attention to detail is necessary to maintain accurate communication records.
Training in electronic communications procedures and devices is essential
Background in dispatch operations or electronic equipment operation is desirable
The incumbent must possess a strong leadership and decision-making skills
Able to manage the safety and/or security and asset protection department in a resource organization.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP

27714.description:
We are currently seeking an experienced
Operational Risk Officer
to join our Risk and Compliance team and lead our efforts in ensuring quality risk management in the business.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The Operational Risk Officer is responsible for assisting the Chief Risk & Compliance Officer for the development and maintenance of a well-defined Enterprise Risk Management Framework. This role involves implementing operational risk management frameworks, conducting risk assessments, and ensuring that operational risks are managed in accordance with the company’s risk appetite, policies, and procedures.
WHAT YOU WILL BRING WITH YOUR EXPERIENCE
Policy Development and Management
Assist in the development of risks management frameworks and risk management plan.
Familiarize with the best practice on Risk Management and its application on day-to-day Management of risks.
Implement the risk management plan and perform relevant quality control assurance checks to ensure adherence.
Operational Risk Assessment, Reporting and Monitoring
Develop and regularly perform the risk assessment with the company.
Perform activities of the Integrated Risk Management unit, including RCSA, KRI, Control Assurance activities etc.
Assist the CRO in Business Continuity Management (BCM), including development and updating of relevant BCM policies and processes.
Monitor and report operational risk incidents, including breaches, losses, and near misses, and recommend corrective actions.
Prepare reports on operational risks to CRO and Board Risk Management and Compliance Committee.
Regulatory Analysis and Training
Research and understand changes in the organisation both internal and external factors.
Work with the CRO to develop risk management guidance materials, training resources, and controls.
Plan and conduct training sessions for staff, as applicable
Additional Key responsibilities
Work closely with other departments to integrate risk management practices into business processes and decision-making.
Conduct site visits as necessary to identify and evaluate risks.
Support executive/senior management on required activities where necessary.
WHAT YOU WILL BRING WITH YOUR BACKGROUND
Graduate Degree in Business Studies, Law, Accounting, or specific training in risk management
Preferably with experience in financial institution industry with a focus on risk management or similar roles such as compliance management, or internal audit
Strong understanding of the regulatory and legal framework relevant to the financial institution industry
Team player who can collaborate and support colleagues and peers across the organization while still being able to work independently and professionally as needed.
Results-oriented with the ability to meet deadlines on assignments, manage multiple demands, and work with individuals of various individuals within the organization.
Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook, and Visio
Analytical and inquisitive mindset
Excellent time management and organizational skills
Ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
Committed to self-development.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral
How to Apply:
If you are passionate about a career in Risk and Compliance field, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this position.
Please address your application to
Head of Human Capital
, Moni Plus, PO Box 1748, Boroko, NCD via email
[email protected]
and apply now. Please note only shortlisted applicants will be contacted to proceed. Applications close
Friday 17
th
July 2026.
We offer competitive compensation and benefits, including health insurance, and professional development opportunities.
Apply

Company :
Hastings Deering (PNG) Limited
About Us:
Hastings Deering (PNG) Limited is one of the largest Caterpillar dealer networks in the world. We sell, service and support the complete range of Caterpillar machinery used in the mining, construction, agricultural, materials handling and government sectors.  Over the last 75 years, we have built a reputation for hiring and developing the industry’s best and delivering an exemplary level of service to our customers and colleagues.
About the Role:
We currently have an excellent opportunity for a
Service Administrator
to join our Service team based in Lae. This role primarily exists to provide administrative support to the Service Department to ensure that our customers receive the best quality product and service.
The successful candidate will be reported to the
Service Manager
, and your competence and experience will include:
Service Coordination & Administration
Proven experience supporting service administration functions, including job setup, WIP management, and system maintenance.
Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting service targets, turnaround times, and quality standards.
​
Scheduling & Support
Capability to support cost control initiatives and resolve vendor or invoice discrepancies.
Coordinate and maintain technician schedules in collaboration with the Service Supervisor/Manager.
Customer Service & Communication
Customer focused mindset, delivering a high-quality, cost-effective service and supporting minimal customer complaints.
Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, working effectively with managers, supervisors, technicians, and vendors.
Reporting & Data Management
Maintain accurate data entry in service systems and ensure data integrity.
Support the Service Manager with performance tracking and reporting.​
Compliance & Process Improvement
Experience ensuring accuracy of service documentation, labor hours, job costing, and purchase orders.
Competence in supporting KPIs, CPS metrics, reporting, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Safety
Ensure safety goals are achieved through personal commitment, no harm to self or others and participation in safety initiatives.
Ensure safety procedures and practices are implemented and applied.
​
About You:
You will bring the following skills and experience to the role:
Year 12 Certificate is desirable
Tertiary Qualifications – Office Management/Business Administration
Minimum two years in a similar administration or workshop administrator role.
Knowledge of Caterpillar products, parts and services.
Strong customer focus, good communication, negotiating, planning and organization skills
Excellent computer skills and knowledge working with Microsoft Applications (Project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Microsoft Dynamics AX).
To express interest in this challenging and rewarding role, submit your application including current updated CV, copies of certificates, references, valid police clearance and apply via Workday Career page.
To Apply: Click on the “Apply” button.
Enquiries: Please call our HR Team on (675) 300 8300
Only Shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Applications close Friday 17thJuly 2026.
Apply

27643.description:
The New Porgera Limited now has a vacancy for qualified and experienced individuals in the position of
Senior Advisor – Community Development
About the role
We are seeking experienced and results-driven Senior Advisors to lead and support the design, management, coordination, and delivery of NPL’s integrated community development portfolio across Food Security, Agriculture, Livelihoods, and Social Cohesion programs. These roles are critical to the successful implementation of NPL’s Community Development Management Plan and the advancement of national content objectives.
Working closely with community stakeholders, internal teams, government agencies, development partners, and service providers, the successful candidates will help ensure that community development initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable outcomes. Programs will be aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), Government of Papua New Guinea (GoPNG) development priorities, and community-identified needs.
In this role, you will.
Lead the development and delivery Food Security, Agriculture, and Social Cohesion programs.
Oversee the disciplined management of multiple projects, ensuring timely delivery and achievement of program objectives.
Coordinate and implement rapid-response initiatives that address immediate community priorities and needs.
Ensure all programs are aligned with the NPL’s Community Development Plan, Community Development Committee (CDC) priorities, the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and Government of Papua New Guinea (GoPNG) development plans.
Manage, mentor, and support a small team of program advisors and officers to achieve key performance indicators (KPIs) and maintain disciplined program execution.
Support program baseline assessments, midline reviews, internal audits, and evaluation activities.
Ensure all initiatives are monitored against SDG-aligned indicators and contribute to the achievement of defined SDG targets.
Liaise and maintain effective partnerships with service providers, NGOs, government agencies, and other external stakeholders.
Lead program reporting and performance monitoring using approved systems and tools and contribute to quarterly and annual performance reviews.
About You
To succeed in this role, the ideal candidate will possess the following qualifications and experience
You will demonstrate a ‘One Team’ approach, providing effective leadership and development for your local team to reinforce NPL’s culture and values, always promoting a safe work environment.  The position requires a high energy individual, hands-on management style and desire to continuously improve you and your team’s knowledge and systems and methods of work.
Qualifications & Experience:
Degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Community Development, Economics, Public Policy, Social Sciences or related discipline.
Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing programs in or more of following areas: Food Security, Agriculture, Social Cohesion, Livilhood or community development programs.
Strong understanding of community development, rural development, PNG government systems and development partners ecosystem supporting community development.
Demonstrated ability to apply structured discipline to project planning, execution and reporting.
Experience in managing Food Security, Agriculture, Social Cohesion or Livilhood programs
Familiarity with SDG frameworks, program baselining, and results-based management.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and data collection tools.
Skilled in facilitation, reporting, and partnership coordination.
Proficiency in Borealis, Power BI, Microsoft Office and familiarity with data collection tools.
Mobilization Requirement
This is a PNG National Staff position, a site-based role on a Fly in Fly out arrangement with rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off. Must successfully pass a pre-employment medical including drug and alcohol screening. (This will be arranged only for successful candidates who progress after the interview stage) and have an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months).
Senior Advisor – Community Development
Embrace an exciting career opportunity with New Porgera Limited as a
Senior Advisor – Community Development.
In this dynamic role, you’ll play a pivotal part in fostering positive relationships with local communities, ensuring respectful and beneficial land access agreements. You’ll have the chance to work with dedicated professionals and cutting-edge resources in a supportive environment that values safety, collaboration, and ongoing Career development and progression. This FIFO position offers a great work-life balance, along with competitive compensation, Flexible benefits, a generous life and health Insurance Cover. Make a meaningful impact in your career and the host community with us at New Porgera Limited!
Closing Date: Friday 17
th
July 2025
Apply

27623.description:
PNG Air, renowned for its extensive network covering over 26 destinations throughout Papua New Guinea, operates the largest fleet of ATR 72-600 & ATR 42-600 series aircraft in the region. As the Airline of Choice, we're committed to delivering a world-class experience with competitive fares, unparalleled cargo rates, and a focus on safety and on-time performance for our valued customers and stakeholders.
FINANCE INTERNAL AUDIT MANAGER
We are pleased to announce an open vacancy exists in our Finance Department for a qualified and experienced
Finance Internal Audit Manager
.
Based in Port Moresby, this position will operationally report to the Chief Financial Officer according to the specific description outlined below. is responsible for providing independent and objective assurance over PNG Air's financial, operational and compliance activities. The role evaluates the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls, governance processes, enterprise risk management and financial reporting controls while promoting continuous improvement across the organization.
The incumbent leads risk-based internal audits, investigates control weaknesses and fraud risks, ensures compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements, and provides practical recommendations to strengthen governance, safeguard company assets and improve operational efficiency.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Develop and maintain the annual risk-based Internal Audit Plan.
Conduct financial enterprise-wide risk assessments to determine audit priorities.
Present audit plans to Executive Management team.
Ensure audit coverage aligns with PNG Air's strategic objectives.
Lead audits of all financial processes
Evaluate the effectiveness of financial and operational internal controls.
Review segregation of duties.
Identify weaknesses in internal control environments.
Recommend practical control improvements.
Monitor implementation of agreed management actions.
Conduct operational audits across all departments
Lead fraud investigations.
Identify fraud indicators and emerging risks.
Review whistle-blower reports.
Recommend fraud prevention controls.
Support enterprise risk management activities.
Report significant risks to Executive Management.
Work with Executive Management to assess adequacy of mitigation plans
Prepare professional audit reports.
Present findings to Executive Management.
Provide practical recommendations.
Monitor closure of audit findings.
Escalate overdue actions
Provide audit documentation.
Assist management in resolving audit findings.
Supervise Internal Audit staff.
Allocate audit assignments.
Review working papers.
Maintain professional audit standards.
QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCES
Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance or related discipline.

The National Development Bank Limited (“NDB”) of Papua New Guinea invites suitable candidates for the vacant position of Sales and Service Manager for
LAE
AND KOKOPO
branch.

Key responsibilities
Ensure excellent customer service is provided by all branch staff.
Grow the Branch’s active loan book to a profitable level.
Control the branch operating cost according to budget and minimize expenses on consumables and incidental costs to branch operations.
Ensure bank fund high-value loan customers at a desirable accepted turn-around time.

Be actively involved with loans officers in conducting immediate personal collection visits to individual and business borrowers as soon as loans fall into arrears even at day one of default.
Diarize loan repayment due dates and to prevent loans from falling into arrears.
Promote creative marketing strategy at the Branch and sell the bank’s products through business awareness meetings.
Contact and work with other local organizations, provincial, district and local level government authorities and communities to promote a positive image for NDB.
Be able to minimize risks associated with the bank operations and increase productivity.
Be able to identify opportunities in agriculture (including livestock), tourism, fisheries and forestry and actively engage to selling the bank’s lending products.
Providing mentoring, in-house training and career development support for officers within the branch.

Minimum qualifications of first degree in banking; business, finance, economics or a related field.
At least 5 years’ experience in banking management, particularly in a lending environment, and proven management level experience.
Well versed with the bank’s lending regulations, policies and guidelines.
Possess excellent communication, people management, team building, management, financial, computer and public relation skills.
Conversant with the following technical skills relating to; lending appraisal, financial analysis; loan security documentation; loan asset management or recovery protocols.

Background knowledge in General Office Administration, Document Management System (Laserfiche), Supplier/ Service Provider coordination, Asset Monitoring and other duties.

27303.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our underground mining team, you will report to the Shotcrete Supervisor and in this role will be required to ensure delivery of concrete mixes from the batch plant to required locations underground of the mine are carried out in a safe and efficient manner and in accordance with K92 Mining site requirements and procedures
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include.
Operate and maintain Underground Agitator Truck according to all K92 Plan Operations & Maintenance procedures and fault reporting systems.
Perform prestart and troubleshooting on Underground Agitator Truck and associated equipment to identify and remedy issues that may arise.
Actively monitor the condition of mixed product to ensure product does not set prematurely in the mixing bowl.
Proactively engage with the Shotcrete Supervisor to provide technical advice and support to the Shotcrete Teams to ensure equipment availability and reliability targets are achieved and optimised against budget.
Respond to routine and emergency calls for repair, service and/or support within the mine site area as required to ensure downtime on equipment is minimised.
Support and assist the Shotcrete Supervisor to ensure the rectification of identified defects in both equipment and mixed product to improve and optimise availability and reliability targets.
Work closely with the Shotcrete Supervisor to assess performance and identify improvement projects to maximise results, reduce risk and implement cost management initiatives.
Demonstrates personal responsibility for own health and safety whilst setting clear expectations of relevant legal obligations, safe workplace practices and HSE operating practices to others, holding them accountable for their actions.
Perform general housekeeping within and around responsible work area.
Ensure equipment maintenance is conducted by competent technicians in a safe manner and in accordance with established procedures.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you
Possess a current Class 4 Drivers Licence that allows operation of a Underground Agitator Truck on public roads – (Essential)
Previous experience as an underground Agitator Truck Operator – (Desirable)
Commitment to safety – (Essential)
Knowledge of Underground Agitator Truck’s performance capabilities – (Essential)
Ability to work autonomously independent with limited supervision – (Essential)
Demonstrate abilities to work within a team environment – (Essential)
Knowledge of concrete additives and aggregates – (Desirable)
Previous experience working within the mining industry – (Desirable)
General knowledge of underground equipment – (Desirable)
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

27696.description:
Research Officer – Ministerial Committees, Grade 14
JOB DESCRIPTION
To assist the Assistant Secretary–Ministerial Committees by undertaking research on economic and sectoral policy issues, analysis, planning and providing advice on how to address the needs of the Department to assist with the effective and efficient delivery of Treasury priorities and objectives.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Assist the Assistant Secretary–Ministerial Committees through the effective delivery of medium to long term strategic analysis for Treasury and management of the Ministerial Committees Branch by coordinating Branch activities, empowering and assisting with the derivation of policies and strategies and supporting other Branch and Treasury staff in the delivery of the priorities of the Branch:
Continuous program of attending to all Treasury related economic issues with the relevant ministerial committees on behalf of the department.
Establishment of a register to record all incoming ministerial requests, queries and having consultations across Treasury, other government agencies and external agencies including donor partners on matters relevant to Treasury’s strategic development.
Represent the Branch/Department as required to promote the Branch objectives and priorities.
MAJOR DUTIES
Day to day management of a continuous program of review of business processes in Treasury to encourage the development and adoption of more cohesive and consistent practices and for the organisation to be able to take advantage of internal efficiencies. Foster the development of a culture of continuous improvement to enhance the delivery of Treasury outcomes.
Implementation and management of a communications network to facilitate consultation across Treasury and with other agencies and external bodies including donor partners, on matters which impact at a strategic level on Treasury. Act as central point of contact in Treasury for the consultation process.
Monitoring and evaluation of issues of strategic importance to Treasury. Preparation of input to corporate and strategic planning documents.  Preparation of ad hoc papers and presentations to management on strategic issues.
Support to the Assistant Secretary – Ministerial Committees by way of draft briefings and input to correspondence, the Treasury website, research and provision of logistical advice as required.
Support the Assistant Secretary – Ministerial Committees through the development and maintenance of positive relationships across the department, focusing on continuous improvement to Treasury processes and services, and by remaining flexible and responsive when new priorities emerge.
Provide advice and guidance to Treasury staff at all levels on professional development opportunities and maintaining a transparent framework of the reporting of performance against these plans.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCES AND SKILLS
Essential

27695.description:

JOB DESCRIPTION
PURPOSE
To assist the Principal Parliamentary Liaison Officer with the effective and efficient management of Treasury’s relationships with the Minister Treasury / Treasurer and his/her office, the national government, other government ministers, and the National Parliament and its Committees.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
To contribute as directed to the effective management and delivery of parliamentary liaison services for Treasury by the Parliamentary Liaison Section in the Branch, and assist with the derivation of policies and strategies to support other Branch and Treasury staff in the delivery of the priorities of the Branch:
Assist Treasury staff with the collation and evaluation of information requests from the Minister Treasurer and his/her office, other government agencies and the National Parliament and its Committees.
Maintain a database of requests distributed to the relevant Division(s), assist Treasury staff on the form and structure of responses as required. Regularly review and report on the progress of information requests to ensure timely responses are provided to the requesting party.
Represent the Branch/Department as required to promote the Branch objectives and priorities.
MAJOR DUTIES
Ensure all briefing requests are appropriately recorded and regularly review and monitor the responses due for all portfolio related requests for information. Assist Treasury staff with background information on similar or related questions to requests received for information.
Support the Principal Parliamentary Liaison Officer by way of draft briefings and input to correspondence, the Treasury website, and research and logistical advice as required.

Provide support and assistance to junior staff in the Parliamentary Liaison and Public Relations Branch.

Bachelor Degree in Public Administration/Management, Public Finance, Communications, English, Journalism or related discipline from a recognized university or learning institution.
Work experience
: A significant amount of relevant work experience in directly supporting senior executive staff and managing correspondence and documentation for senior committees.
Teamwork
: Able to work well with colleagues and effectively mentor junior staff. Manage the team’s response to requests in a timely manner and share relevant information with the Division, the Department and with other stakeholders. 27691.description:
Principal Budget Officer- Administration Sector, Grade 16
JOB DESCRIPTION
To provide analysis and advice relating to budget allocations for assigned agencies (budget preparation) and then monitor and assess the spending and program delivery of these agencies (budget execution and maintenance).
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Assist the Assistant Secretary - Administration Sector in providing leadership and managing activities of the Branch, and guides staff to coordinate budget and analyse budgetary issues, prepare fiscal reports, assess the budget outcome and policy related issues including advice on expenditure review through written documents (briefs, reports, letters and policy documents).
MAJOR DUTIES
Provide advice on the preparation of the annual budget and evaluation and monitoring of the annual budget and the provision of feedback, as required, to management.
Ensure that planned activities are performed in accordance with the approved divisional work program.
Ensure that the annual budget is prepared in accordance with government policies and decisions.
Participate actively in the conduct of quarterly budget reviews and prepare reports on the outcome for management to present to CACC and Ministerial Economic Committee/National Executive Council where required.
Ensure monthly warrant authorities are processed for all Administration Sector Agencies and monthly grants to Statutory Authorities are remitted.
Ensure assigned agencies work programs are in line with the functions of the agencies and government directives and provide feedback.
Evaluate the performance of subordinates and supervise to ensure efficient and effective daily conduct of the branch operations.
Enforce discipline and model behaviour in respect of attendance, punctuality and compliance with Public Service General Orders and Treasury values.
Prepare briefs and draft responses to correspondences and queries on budgetary matter.
Provide technical assistance and advice to assigned agencies on budgetary matters.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
QUALIFICATIONS & ADDITIONAL EXPERIENCE
Essential
Qualifications:
Bachelor Degree in Accounting, Commerce or Economics or a related field from a recognized university.
Work experience:
Eight (8) years or more of relevant work experience (for example, experience working on Budgeting or Financial policy or analysis) as well as demonstrated management experience.
Teamwork:
Able to work well with colleagues and effectively mentor junior staff. Manage the team's response to requests in a timely manner and share relevant information with the Division, the Department and with other stakeholders. Contribute to identifying development needs and building the capacity and capability of the Branch through regular, honest and robust performance reviews and discussions, which are undertaken in accordance with Departmental and Government policies. All performance reviews and related documentation must be updated and accurately reflect the performance and development needs of each team member reporting to this role.
Workload and time management:
Contribute to identifying team priorities, and share or allocate specific tasks within team and to ensure competing deadlines are met. Manage own tasks within this environment. Promote effective and efficient service delivery.
Strategic and budget planning skills:
Contribute, as required, to identifying divisional and department strategic goals and budget plans, and assist in the preparation of related documentation to support the meeting of these strategic goals and budget plans.
Financial management:
Ensure all expenditure, acquittals and other financial and commercial transactions strictly adhere to Departmental and Government-wide policies and/or legislation.
Staff supervision:
In conjunction with the Assistant Secretary, communicate to the team how their work fits into Treasury's broader strategic goals and provide feedback to staff.
Legislative knowledge:
Good knowledge about the range of Acts, laws and policies governing the work of Department of Treasury.
Values:
Demonstrate and practice high levels of integrity, honesty, accountability, respect and wisdom and accept responsibility for one's own actions at all times.
Zero tolerance of any unethical activity or behaviour:
Must be a positive role model on ethical behaviour for staff and demonstrate personal qualities of honesty, fairness and professionalism.
Computing:
Demonstrate substantial proficiency in the use of email and internet, in the application of software such as MS Word and MS Excel to perform complex tasks, and in the creation of presentations using MS PowerPoint.
Technical:
A demonstrated knowledge/understanding of Public Finance (Management) Act and related instructions, Organic Law on Provincial & Local Level Governments, Public Service (Management) Act and General Orders, Public Service Policies on Accounting, Procedures and Systems, Government Accounting Systems and Appropriation Acts.
